g.text: A4, print 100%. Clockwise. Outside to inside: MSB to LSB.
Read on a sector centre, not on a boundary. Position 0: top.
Track radii: 28..88 mm, 10 mm per track. Disk diameter: 176 mm.
Bits are Gray symbols; decode them, do not read as binary position.
Teaching diagram only. Not a calibrated physical encoder.
